rounds.text: The bull case leans heavily on low multiples, but the underlying top-line reality reveals a stagnating business that does not justify investor enthusiasm [E1], [E2], [E6], [E7]. Compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months crawls at a meager 6%, showing no decisive breakout from its historical sluggishness [E16]. Income investors also receive nothing back from their capital, as the dividend yield sits firmly at 0.00% [E4]. Conceded: the company achieves a higher ROA of 7.3% compared to the sector benchmark of 6.2% [E8].
